tutorial.faceDown: In Pontoon **every hand is dealt face down, including the banker's**. Unlike blackjack there is no up-card to read.
tutorial.rank: Strength is not just a total: **a Pontoon (ace + ten-value, two cards) beats a five card trick (exactly five cards, 21 or less) beats any points**. The top two pay double.
tutorial.stick: **You cannot stick below 15.** Below that you must keep drawing, which makes 12–14 the worst place to be.
tutorial.buy: **Buy raises and draws, but is dead once the hand has twisted.** Choosing how to take the first card is the real decision.
tutorial.banker: **A player who makes a Pontoon takes the bank next deal.** When you bank you place no stake and decide the draw at the end.
tutorial.controls: Buttons for the declarations and the next round.

frontendHint.pontoonBuySafe: At 11 or under no card can bust you — raise and draw
frontendHint.pontoonDrawSafe: At 11 or under no card can bust you — draw
frontendHint.pontoonMustDraw: Under 15 you cannot stick, so you have to draw
frontendHint.pontoonStickBorderline: Borderline, but drawing busts you more often than not
frontendHint.pontoonFiveCard: One card from a five-card trick, which beats any points hand
frontendHint.pontoonSplit: A pair — split it into two hands
